target_pattern: Use el/la/los/las for generic concepts, gustar categories, scheduled days, body parts, clothing, titles, streets, and languages as subjects; drop the article after ser + day, direct address, and hablar/aprender/saber + language.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Dropping articles wherever English drops them, especially with generics, body parts, clothing, and days of the week.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish marks whole categories and shared context with definite articles. If the noun refers to a general concept, a habitual day, or something clearly yours (body/clothing), use el/la/los/las instead of mirroring English zero-article patterns.
target_pattern_formula: generic/concept: La naturaleza / La salud / La democracia
gustar category: Me gusta la musica / Me gustan los perros
scheduled day: Nos vemos el lunes
ser + day (no article): Hoy es lunes
body/clothing (owner clear): Me duele la cabeza / Ponte el abrigo
title about someone: El doctor Garcia es...
street: Vivo en la calle + name
language as subject: El espanol es util
natural_examples: Hablo espanol, pero el espanol es dificil.

controlled_recombination.instructions: Write each sentence in Spanish with the correct definite article use (include or omit as natural Spanish requires).
prompts_en: We will see each other on Monday.
Doctor Garcia, I need your help.
Health is the most important thing.
Democracy is important for a free society.
Mathematics is difficult for many students.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as directed.
drills: Base: La naturaleza es impresionante. -> change subject to la salud.
Base: Me gusta la musica. -> change to los perros and adjust verb.
Base: Nos vemos el lunes. -> change day to viernes.
Base: Hoy es lunes. -> change to martes.
Base: Me duele la cabeza. -> change body part to la espalda.
Base: Ponte el abrigo. -> change clothing to la chaqueta.
Base: El doctor Garcia es muy inteligente. -> change to direct address asking for help.
Base: La abuela esta afuera. -> change to direct address: Grandpa, I need help.
Base: Vivo en la calle Caracol. -> change street name to Reforma.
Base: El espanol es util para el trabajo. -> rewrite with Hablo espanol at work (no article after hablar).
Base: La democracia es importante. -> make it negative: Democracy is not perfect.
Base: Las matematicas son dificiles. -> change subject to la historia.
Base: Me gusta el cafe. -> change to question: Do you like coffee?
Base: La muerte es un tema incomodo. -> change to plural people: for many people.
Base: El sol esta caliente hoy. -> change to: The moon is beautiful tonight.

prompts: I like music in general. (Me gusta musica. vs Me gusta la musica.)
Today is Monday. (Hoy es el lunes. vs Hoy es lunes.)
We will meet on Monday. (Nos vemos lunes. vs Nos vemos el lunes.)
My head hurts. (Me duele mi cabeza. vs Me duele la cabeza.)
Put on your shirt. (Ponte tu camisa. vs Ponte la camisa.)
Dr. Lopez is busy (talking about him). (Doctor Lopez esta ocupado. vs El doctor Lopez esta ocupado.)
Dr. Lopez, I need help (speaking to him). (El doctor Lopez, necesito ayuda. vs Doctor Lopez, necesito ayuda.)
Spanish is interesting (language as concept). (Espanol es interesante. vs El espanol es interesante.)
I speak Spanish. (Hablo el espanol. vs Hablo espanol.)
I live on Main Street. (Vivo en calle Principal. vs Vivo en la calle Principal.)

guided_personal_writing.instructions: Write one Spanish sentence for each specific meaning.
prompts: Write that nature relaxes you after a stressful week.
Write that you like coffee in general.
Write that you and a colleague will meet on Wednesday.
Write that today is Friday.
Write that your back hurts after sitting all day.
Write that you are telling someone to put on their jacket before going out.
Write that your doctor is very professional (talking about them to someone else).
Write that you are addressing your doctor directly and asking for an appointment.
Write that health matters more than money (general concept).
Write that you live on a street named Juarez in your city.
Write that you speak Portuguese at work.
Write that English is useful for international business (language as concept).
Write that education opens opportunities (general concept).
Write that your grandmother is in the living room (third person).
Write that you are calling your grandfather directly and asking for advice.

reverse_conceptual_expression.instructions: Write natural Spanish; do not mirror English article use literally.
prompts_en: My knee hurts after the run.
Wear your shoes before you leave.
I want to learn French this year.
Professor Ruiz, can you review this?

common_errors.why_it_happens: Generic concept keeps English zero-article pattern.
Gustar category nouns are treated as bare nouns.
Scheduled day of week drops article like English.
Ser + day incorrectly gets definite article.
Possessive is copied from English for body parts.
Clothing instruction uses possessive instead of definite article.
Title in third-person reference drops required article.
common_errors.correct_spanish: El doctor Garcia es muy inteligente.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Direct address keeps third-person article pattern.
Article is added after hablar even though Spanish omits it.
Street names drop article like many English patterns.

controlled_recombination: El doctor Garcia es muy inteligente.
La salud es lo mas importante.
La educacion es esencial para el progreso.
El espanol es util para el trabajo.
La democracia es importante para una sociedad libre.
Las matematicas son dificiles para muchos estudiantes.
pattern_mutation: La muerte es un tema incomodo para muchas personas.
La luna es hermosa esta noche.
reverse_conceptual_expression: La musica me ayuda a concentrarme.
Me duele la rodilla despues de correr.
Ponte los zapatos antes de salir.
